_comment: Native SQL for the single shared SUBMISSIONS table (all templates live in one table; TemplateId separates them). Placeholders in {curly} are validated identifiers wrapped with [] by the store; @named parameters carry all values. Edit here without redeploying (reloadOnChange).
TableExists: SELECT CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID(@tableName, N'U') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
CreateTable: CREATE TABLE [SUBMISSIONS] ([Id] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [PK_SUBMISSIONS] PRIMARY KEY, [TemplateId] BIGINT NOT NULL, [VersionNo] INT NULL, [Status] NVARCHAR(50) NULL, [SurveyId] BIGINT NULL, [AssignmentId] BIGINT NULL, [FilledByRole] NVARCHAR(30) NULL, [SubmittedBy] NVARCHAR(256) NULL, [SubmittedDate] DATETIMEOFFSET NULL, [ClientSubmissionId] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, [Created] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_SUBMISSIONS_Created] DEFAULT SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()); CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_SUBMISSIONS_TemplateId] ON [SUBMISSIONS] ([TemplateId]); CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_SUBMISSIONS_SurveyId] ON [SUBMISSIONS] ([SurveyId]);
ColumnExists: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(@tableName, N'U') AND [name] = @columnName) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
ColumnNames: SELECT [name] FROM sys.columns WHERE [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(@tableName, N'U');
_comment_ColumnMaxLength: Bytes, not characters — an NVARCHAR(100) column reports 200. NVARCHAR(MAX) reports -1. Used by reconciliation to tell a column that is narrower than the type its field now wants.
ColumnMaxLength: SELECT [max_length] FROM sys.columns WHERE [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(@tableName, N'U') AND [name] = @columnName;
_comment_AlterColumn: Only ever issued to WIDEN an NVARCHAR column (see WidenIfNarrowerAsync) — widening preserves every existing row, narrowing would fail or truncate.
IndexExists: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(@tableName, N'U') AND [name] = @indexName) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
_comment_ClientSubmissionIndex: Filtered so the rows that carry no client key — every fill entered directly against the API — are exempt from the uniqueness rule rather than colliding on NULL. SQL Server refuses to build a filtered index unless QUOTED_IDENTIFIER and ANSI_NULLS are ON; SqlClient sets both by default, but they are set explicitly here because this statement runs on the submit path and a session that had them off would fail every fill, not just this index.
CreateClientSubmissionIndex: SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON; SET ANSI_NULLS ON; CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [UX_SUBMISSIONS_ClientSubmissionId] ON [SUBMISSIONS] ([TemplateId], [ClientSubmissionId]) WHERE [ClientSubmissionId] IS NOT NULL;
_comment_UpdateAnswers: Rewrites named answer columns on a row that already exists. Deliberately narrow — no base column is touched, and there is no way to reach it without naming a submission id. The ordinary way to change a survey's answers is a new fill, which writes its own row; this exists for the one case that cannot be a new fill, namely attaching media to an already-approved survey, whose lifecycle refuses one.
GetLatestBySurvey: SELECT TOP 1 {select} FROM [SUBMISSIONS] WHERE [SurveyId] = @surveyId AND [TemplateId] = @templateId ORDER BY [Id] DESC;
ListBySurvey: SELECT {select} FROM [SUBMISSIONS] WHERE [SurveyId] = @surveyId AND [TemplateId] = @templateId ORDER BY [Id];
ListByTemplate: SELECT {select} FROM [SUBMISSIONS] WHERE [TemplateId] = @templateId ORDER BY [Id] DESC OFFSET @skip ROWS FETCH NEXT @take ROWS ONLY;
